print_errors.note: Printed without the yeh after dal (expected وَتَهْدِيَنِي/وتهديني); kept as printed.

notes: p165 continues p164 (prayer 90 broken mid-sentence) -> 165+; 166, 167, 168 also continue mid-prayer -> +. On p165 a horizontal rule is printed under «الَّذِي ضَرَّ مَنْ عَصَاهُ» in the last text line (underline, no markup available; ignored). In الْمنْعِ / الْمظَاهِرِ / الْمسْخِ the mim carries no vowel in print (only the lam sukun and next-letter sukun), transcribed so. اللهِ/لله with printed case kasra written باللَّهِ / للَّهِ / عَنِ اللَّهِ per §2. Quran encoded per Tanzil where it matches the image; no ۞ is printed before المؤمنون 75 or الشورى 27. Prayer number on p165 printed «٩١/ ٩٢-», written ٩١/٩٢-. Footnote kept as «(١١/ ٢١٨)» with the printed space.
